title: Implement LICHEN to IRC relay: observe /msg/inbox, filter by group, format and send to IRC channels
description: Implement the LICHEN-to-IRC direction of the bridge. Observe the gateway /msg/inbox CoAP endpoint for incoming authenticated LICHEN messages. Filter messages by configured group/realm mappings. Format messages for IRC with origin provenance (native /128 address and timestamp) using IRCv3 message tags when negotiated, falling back to readable text prefix. Apply rate limiting, queue bounds, and UTF-8 validation. Sanitize IRC control codes and CTCP. Implement deduplication using persistent message IDs and bridge-instance IDs.
